title: 塞奇莫尔公用事业激励参考表
instruction:
您是 Bianca Maldonado，Sedgemoor Lighting & Controls 的区域销售主管。 Cormac Nazari 在下一季度开始之前需要一份工地参考表，因为我们的商业 LED 改造报价不断输给能够立即报价激励的承包商。在工作目录的顶层构建`sedgemoor_utility_incentive_reference.xlsx`。覆盖马萨诸塞州和罗德岛州，包括投资者拥有的、市政的和商业代表可能遇到的其他电力服务地区，并表明哪些照明激励计划可以视为下一季度开放。销售代表需要找到一个区域、一个可行的 LED 测量值，以及他们可以负责任地引用的数字或范围，而无需致电办公室。一些管理员 PDF 已经过时，一些详细信息位于贸易盟友门户后面，摘要页面与规定表格不一致，因此请使验证日期、源链接、不确定性和未解决的领域可见，而不是平滑它们。当工作表无法支持完整的答案时，请包含可用的后备报价。保持该表在工作现场可读，并且不要将其转变为法律、税务、工程或客户资格确定；这些界限对于 Priya Merriweather 和 Solveig Wickramasinghe 来说很重要。仅使用您可以证实的信息，并保留不受支持的数字。
工作簿必须仅包含一个工作表，并且必须准确保存在该文件名下。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `sedgemoor_utility_incentive_reference.xlsx` — 单一工作表、现场可用的公用事业激励参考表，用于马萨诸塞州和罗德岛州的商业 LED 改造报价。 （仅一份工作表。；使用准确的文件名并将其保存在起始工作目录的顶层。；涵盖指定的州和相关电力服务区域，包括适用的市辖区。；使源出处、验证日期、不确定性、报价安全状态和未解决的覆盖范围可见。；不要在已确认的情况下陈述不受支持的激励数字。；包括针对不完整或无法验证的情况的实际后备路径。；保持内容适合广泛的非专业销售受众，并将销售指导与销售指导明确分开法律、税务、工程和最终客户资格决策。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

Massachusetts + Rhode Island | Reference period: Q4 2026 | Last field review: 24 Aug 2026 | Owner: Sales Operations / Incentive Desk
WHEN THE SHEET CANNOT COMPLETE THE ANSWER

QUOTE-SAFE: rate has retained source + source period + review date; still subject to final approval.
CONFIRM BEFORE QUOTING: use only qualified discussion language; administrator verifies exact measure/rate.
UNAVAILABLE: do not give a dollar figure. “Unknown” is not $0.

A program landing page is not proof of a fixture rate. Keep the table/portal source behind any number. Stale, undated and portal-only material stays visibly limited. Changed terms never carry forward without a new review.

Say: “An incentive may be available; the utility/administrator must confirm it before you rely on it.” Collect serving utility, service address/account number, customer type, existing/proposed fixture + controls, quantity, wattage, project type and install timing. Send to Incentive Desk for administrator confirmation; never promise an unverified amount.

ROLE BOUNDARIES  |  Sales guidance only — not legal advice, tax advice or tax-credit conclusion, engineering sign-off / load calculation / design certification, or final customer-eligibility determination. Final eligibility, incentive amount, reservation and payment recipient are owned by the utility/program administrator. Escalate changing or uncertain terms to Sales Operations / Incentive Desk.

Primary jobsite fields are A–M. Use the table filters for State or Electric utility / territory. Secondary evidence fields N–V retain the audit trail; all displayed money is USD. “Amount unknown — not zero” means missing evidence, not a confirmed absence of incentive.

criteria.description: 提交的工作簿作为 XLSX 文件成功打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用电子表格库打开文件并确认它可以解析且没有修复警告。

original.criterion: The submitted workbook opens successfully as an XLSX file.
original.grader_hint: Open the file with a spreadsheet library and confirm it parses without repair warnings.

criteria.description: 该工作簿仅包含一张工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作表名称和计数。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly one worksheet.
original.grader_hint: Inspect worksheet names and count.

criteria.description: 该工作表可读，无需在普通笔记本电脑或打印预览范围内水平滚动主要报价字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染或检查列宽；主要字段应该是合理可见的。

original.criterion: The worksheet is readable without requiring horizontal scrolling for the primary quote fields at ordinary laptop or print-preview scale.
original.grader_hint: Render or inspect column widths; primary fields should be reasonably visible.

criteria.description: 该工作表将马萨诸塞州列为涵盖管辖区。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索可见的单元格文本。

original.criterion: The worksheet names Massachusetts as a covered jurisdiction.
original.grader_hint: Search visible cell text.

criteria.description: 该工作表将罗德岛州列为涵盖管辖区。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索可见的单元格文本。

original.criterion: The worksheet names Rhode Island as a covered jurisdiction.
original.grader_hint: Search visible cell text.

criteria.description: 每个实质性计划行都与一个州或管辖区相关联。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个程序记录中是否有非空白管辖区。

original.criterion: Each substantive program row is associated with a state or jurisdiction.
original.grader_hint: Check every program record for a nonblank jurisdiction.

criteria.description: 每个实质性计划行都与电力公司、市政公用事业公司或明确指定的计划管理员相关联。
criteria.evidence: 实用程序或管理员字段
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝仅标识通用状态的行。

original.criterion: Each substantive program row is associated with an electric utility, municipal utility, or clearly named program administrator.
original.grader_hint: Reject rows that identify only a generic state.

criteria.description: 该表将公用事业服务区域与计划管理员区分开来，这些区域是不同的。
criteria.evidence: 单独的字段或明确的措辞
criteria.grader_hint: 如果适用，请寻找区域所有者和管理员。

original.criterion: The sheet distinguishes utility service territory from the program administrator where those are different.
original.grader_hint: Look for both territory owner and administrator when applicable.

criteria.description: 投资者拥有的公用事业领域代表了两个涉及商业计划的州。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估每个州已知的主要商业电力公司的覆盖范围，允许明确的未发现或未解决的记录，而不是无声的遗漏。

original.criterion: Investor-owned utility territories are represented for both covered states where commercial programs are relevant.
original.grader_hint: Assess coverage against the known major commercial electric utilities in each state, allowing a clear not-found or unresolved record rather than silent omission.

criteria.description: 市政或公共权力领域并没有被默默地忽略；该表列出了适用的地区/计划或无法验证覆盖范围的记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找市政条目或明确的承保状态登记册。

original.criterion: Municipal or public-power territories are not silently omitted; the sheet either lists applicable territories/programs or records that coverage could not be verified.
original.grader_hint: Look for municipal entries or an explicit coverage-status register.

criteria.description: 该表提供了一种覆盖状态机制，使未经验证的地区与没有激励的地区区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认这两种情况具有不同的可见标签或解释。

original.criterion: The sheet provides a coverage-status mechanism that makes an unverified territory distinguishable from a territory with no incentive.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the two conditions have different visible labels or explanations.

criteria.description: 代表可以按州过滤或以其他方式查找记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查过滤器、分组或明显可用的状态字段。

original.criterion: A rep can filter or otherwise locate records by state.
original.grader_hint: Check a filter, grouping, or clearly usable state field.

criteria.description: 代表可以按公用事业或服务区域过滤或以其他方式查找记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查过滤器、分组或明显可用的实用程序字段。

original.criterion: A rep can filter or otherwise locate records by utility or service territory.
original.grader_hint: Check a filter, grouping, or clearly usable utility field.

criteria.description: 该表将商业客户与仅限住宅的产品区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个包含的程序都应标识商业适用性或标记为非商业性。

original.criterion: The sheet distinguishes commercial customers from residential-only offerings.
original.grader_hint: Each included program should identify commercial applicability or be marked as not commercial.

criteria.description: 该表将电力照明激励措施与非照明或不相关的效率激励措施区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝与照明无关的通用效率计划列表。

original.criterion: The sheet distinguishes electric lighting incentives from non-lighting or unrelated efficiency incentives.
original.grader_hint: Reject a generic efficiency-program list with no lighting relevance.

criteria.description: LED 改造措施使用实用术语（例如灯具、灯、改造套件或控件）来标识，而不仅仅是程序名称。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查措施描述中是否有可重复识别的照明术语。

original.criterion: LED retrofit measures are identified using practical terms such as fixture, lamp, retrofit kit, or control rather than only a program name.
original.grader_hint: Inspect measure descriptions for rep-recognizable lighting terminology.

criteria.description: 该表确定了控制是否被包含、排除或单独处理（如果这种区别很重要）。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找控制处理，而不仅仅是 LED 措辞。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether controls are included, excluded, or separately treated where that distinction matters.
original.grader_hint: Look for controls treatment, not just LED wording.

criteria.description: 该表确定了规定性与定制性或计算出的激励待遇。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个计划或措施记录都应该使路径显而易见。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies prescriptive versus custom or calculated incentive treatment.
original.grader_hint: Every program or measure record should make the path apparent.

criteria.description: 该表标识了某个项目在指定季度是否开放、关闭、暂停、基于预订或未解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查状态是否是显式的，而不是根据行的存在来推断的。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether a program is open, closed, suspended, reservation-based, or unresolved for the stated quarter.
original.grader_hint: Check that status is explicit rather than inferred from the presence of a row.

criteria.description: 计划状态与验证日期或验证周期相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝未注明日期的当前状态断言。

original.criterion: A program status is tied to a verification date or verification period.
original.grader_hint: Reject undated current-status assertions.

criteria.description: 每个引用或可引用的数字都有一个单位，例如每个灯具、每个灯、每千瓦、每个项目或百分比。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个激励数值。

original.criterion: Each quoted or quoteable figure has a unit such as per fixture, per lamp, per kW, per project, or percentage.
original.grader_hint: Check every numeric incentive value.

criteria.description: 每个汇率或范围均注明货币或明确金额以美元为单位。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找美元符号或明确的美元图例。

original.criterion: Each rate or range states the currency or makes clear that the amount is in US dollars.
original.grader_hint: Look for dollar notation or an explicit USD legend.

criteria.description: 该表将固定规定利率与范围、上限、等级或计算值区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查数字表示是否不意味着错误的精度。

original.criterion: The sheet distinguishes a fixed prescriptive rate from a range, cap, tier, or calculated value.
original.grader_hint: Check that numeric presentation does not imply false precision.

criteria.description: 任何因固定装置、功率、技术、建筑类型或控制条件而变化的费率都表明了相关的限定符。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查有条件利率的条件。

original.criterion: Any rate that varies by fixture, wattage, technology, building type, or control condition states the relevant qualifier.
original.grader_hint: Inspect conditional rates for their conditions.

criteria.description: 该表记录了已知的相关激励上限、最低限度或项目限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查上限/最小值或明确的未知/未解决的标记。

original.criterion: The sheet records relevant incentive caps, minimums, or project limits when known.
original.grader_hint: Check for caps/minimums or an explicit unknown/unresolved marker.

criteria.description: 该表明确了安装前是否需要预先批准或预订（如果适用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求预先批准/预订治疗。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether pre-approval or reservation is required before installation where applicable.
original.grader_hint: Look for pre-approval/reservation treatment.

criteria.description: 该表确定了贸易盟友、批准的承包商或管理员注册条件是否适用（如果适用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查承包商渠道要求。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether a trade ally, approved contractor, or administrator enrollment condition applies where applicable.
original.grader_hint: Check for contractor-channel requirements.

criteria.description: 该表确定是否向客户、承包商、账户持有人或已知的其他方支付奖励。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查付款接收方的处理或明确的未解决状态。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether incentives are paid to the customer, contractor, account holder, or another party where known.
original.grader_hint: Check payment-recipient treatment or an explicit unresolved status.

criteria.description: 该表列出了所需的项目证据，例如发票、设备规格、现有条件文档或安装后证明（如果适用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找超出裸率的证据要求。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies required project evidence such as invoices, equipment specifications, existing-condition documentation, or post-installation proof where applicable.
original.grader_hint: Look for evidence requirements beyond a bare rate.

criteria.description: 该表标识了相关改造、更换、新建和维护活动之间的任何区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查措施范围是否操作清晰。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies any distinction between retrofit, replacement, new construction, and maintenance activity where relevant.
original.grader_hint: Check whether the measure scope is operationally clear.

criteria.description: 该表标识了适用的客户或账户类型，包括相关的小型企业或收入合格的区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查客户群限定条件。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies the applicable customer or account type, including small-business or income-qualified distinctions when relevant.
original.grader_hint: Check for customer segment qualifiers.

criteria.description: 该表列出了影响资格的燃料或最终用途限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找适用的电子帐户和最终使用条件。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies fuel or end-use restrictions when they affect eligibility.
original.grader_hint: Look for electric-account and end-use conditions where applicable.

criteria.description: 该表标识最终确认是否需要公用事业帐号或服务地址。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查帐户级别的确认警告。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies whether a utility account number or service address is needed for final confirmation.
original.grader_hint: Check for account-level confirmation caveat.

criteria.description: 该表将确认的利率与指示性范围或未经核实的数字分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据支持注释检查标签。

original.criterion: The sheet separates confirmed rates from indicative ranges or unverified figures.
original.grader_hint: Check labels against the supporting notes.

criteria.description: 如果没有可识别的来源和验证日期，则不会提供已确认的数字奖励。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据出处审核所有已确认的数字单元格。

original.criterion: No numeric incentive is presented as confirmed without an identifiable source and verification date.
original.grader_hint: Audit all confirmed numeric cells against provenance.

criteria.description: 每条节目记录至少有一个来源引用或明确声明来源无法验证。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查非空白源或透明的未解析状态。

original.criterion: Every program record has at least one source reference or an explicit statement that the source could not be verified.
original.grader_hint: Check for nonblank source or transparent unresolved status.

criteria.grader_hint: 评估来源的身份和特异性。

original.criterion: Source references identify the utility or administrator publication rather than relying only on a search-engine result or an unsourced note.
original.grader_hint: Assess source identity and specificity.

criteria.description: 源引用包括可用的 URL 或其他检索定位器（如果存在）。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查链接或定位器的可检索性。

original.criterion: Source references include a usable URL or other retrieval locator when one exists.
original.grader_hint: Check links or locators for retrievability.

criteria.description: 验证日期在行或程序级别可见，或者明确定义的通用日期适用于所有行。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认任何共同日期的范围。

original.criterion: The verification date is visible at row or program level, or a clearly defined common date applies to all rows.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the scope of any common date.

criteria.description: 陈旧、被取代或未注明日期的材料与当前的验证明显不同。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找陈旧来源的处理方法。

original.criterion: Stale, superseded, or undated material is visibly distinguished from current verification.
original.grader_hint: Look for stale-source treatment.

criteria.description: 当官方摘要和详细费率表不一致时，表会记录分歧，而不是默默地合并这些值。
criteria.evidence: 冲突注释或源比较字段
criteria.grader_hint: 检查多个官方来源的记录并寻找明确的冲突处理。

original.criterion: When an official summary and a detailed rate table disagree, the sheet records the disagreement rather than silently combining the values.
original.grader_hint: Inspect records with multiple official sources and look for explicit conflict handling.

criteria.description: 对于冲突源记录，工作表会标识哪个值可以安全引用，或将数字标记为未解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 默默的选择不会赢得任何荣誉。

original.criterion: For a conflicting-source record, the sheet identifies which value is safe to quote, or marks the figure unresolved.
original.grader_hint: A silent selection earns no credit.

criteria.description: 该表保留了足够的来源详细信息，可以重现相互冲突的官方材料之间的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否保留了相关来源或其标识符。

original.criterion: The sheet preserves enough source detail to reproduce the comparison between conflicting official materials.
original.grader_hint: Check that both relevant sources or their identifiers are retained.

criteria.description: 该表不会将一般计划登陆页面视为没有支持细节的特定固定利率的证明。
criteria.grader_hint: 审计代表费率索赔。

original.criterion: The sheet does not treat a general program landing page as proof of a specific fixture rate without supporting detail.
original.grader_hint: Audit representative rate claims.

criteria.description: 该表将正在宣传的计划与当前条款下符合资格的措施区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找测量级别的资格。

original.criterion: The sheet distinguishes a program being advertised from a measure being eligible under current terms.
original.grader_hint: Look for measure-level qualification.

criteria.description: 仅门户网站的信息被标记为依赖于门户网站，并且当从业者无法检查条款时，不会表示为经过完全验证。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查无法访问的贸易材料的处理。

original.criterion: Portal-only information is marked as portal-dependent and is not represented as fully verified when the practitioner cannot inspect the terms.
original.grader_hint: Check treatment of inaccessible trade-ally material.

criteria.description: 具有发布日期、有效期或修订日期的来源会记录该日期（如果可用）。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源日期捕获。

original.criterion: A source with a publication date, effective period, or revision date records that date when available.
original.grader_hint: Check source-date capture.

criteria.description: 该表明确了参考的季度或有效期限。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找规定的参考期。

original.criterion: The sheet makes the quarter or effective period for the reference explicit.
original.grader_hint: Look for a stated reference period.

criteria.description: 该表在引用安全、引用前确认和不可用记录之间提供了清晰的视觉或文本区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证是否可以区分所有三种操作状态。

original.criterion: The sheet provides a clear visual or textual distinction between quote-safe, confirm-before-quoting, and unavailable records.
original.grader_hint: Verify that all three operational states can be distinguished.

criteria.description: 当区域、资格或费率无法从表格中填写时，该表格包括代表的实用路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 该路径必须告诉代表要沟通什么以及确认属于哪里，而无需发明费率。

original.criterion: The sheet includes a practical path for a rep when territory, eligibility, or rate cannot be completed from the sheet.
original.grader_hint: The path must tell the rep what to communicate and where confirmation belongs, without inventing a rate.

criteria.description: 后备路径可防止销售代表提出未经验证的激励措施作为客户承诺。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的无承诺边界。

original.criterion: The fallback path prevents the rep from presenting an unverified incentive as a customer commitment.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit no-commitment boundary.

criteria.description: 后备路径将缺失的信息与已确认的零激励区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝在这两种情况下使用空白或零。

original.criterion: The fallback path distinguishes missing information from a confirmed zero incentive.
original.grader_hint: Reject a blank or zero used for both conditions.

criteria.description: 该表告诉代表缩小范围或衡量问题所需的最低限度的工作现场事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找服务区域/帐户、项目类型和衡量事实或同等内容。

original.criterion: The sheet tells the rep what minimum jobsite facts are needed to narrow a territory or measure question.
original.grader_hint: Look for service territory/account, project type, and measure facts or equivalent.

criteria.description: 该表确定了谁拥有最终资格或计划确认权，但并不暗示销售代表拥有该决定权。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有权措辞。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies who owns final eligibility or program confirmation without implying that the sales rep owns that determination.
original.grader_hint: Check ownership wording.

criteria.description: 该表规定，当记录不安全时，必须先确认激励措施的可用性或资格，然后客户才能依赖它。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可见的警告。

original.criterion: The sheet states that incentive availability or eligibility must be confirmed before the customer relies on it when the record is not quote-safe.
original.grader_hint: Check visible caveat.

criteria.description: 该表明确排除了代表使用参考资料的法律建议。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索法律边界语言。

original.criterion: The sheet clearly excludes legal advice from the rep's use of the reference.
original.grader_hint: Search for legal boundary language.

criteria.description: 该表明确排除了销售代表对参考资料的使用的税务建议或税收抵免结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索税收边界语言。

original.criterion: The sheet clearly excludes tax advice or tax-credit conclusions from the rep's use of the reference.
original.grader_hint: Search for tax boundary language.

criteria.description: 该表明确地将工程签核、负载计算或设计认证排除在代表使用参考的范围之外。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索工程边界语言。

original.criterion: The sheet clearly excludes engineering sign-off, load calculations, or design certification from the rep's use of the reference.
original.grader_hint: Search for engineering boundary language.

criteria.description: 该表明确排除了销售代表使用参考资料来确定最终客户资格的情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索资格边界语言。

original.criterion: The sheet clearly excludes final customer eligibility determination from the rep's use of the reference.
original.grader_hint: Search for eligibility boundary language.

criteria.description: 该表标识用于维护不确定或变化的程序信息的所有者或升级功能。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否有负责的角色或职能，而不是虚构的个人联系方式。

original.criterion: The sheet identifies an owner or escalation function for maintaining uncertain or changing program information.
original.grader_hint: Check for an accountable role or function, not an invented personal contact.

criteria.description: 该表包括一种识别整个参考的最后审查或更新的方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可见的总体审核日期。

original.criterion: The sheet includes a way to identify the last review or update for the whole reference.
original.grader_hint: Check visible overall review date.

criteria.description: 该表表明，更改后的计划条款不应默默地从上一季度结转。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找替代或重新检查语言。

original.criterion: The sheet indicates that changed program terms should not be silently carried forward from a prior quarter.
original.grader_hint: Look for supersession or recheck language.

criteria.description: 该表在整个记录和图例中使用一致的状态词汇。
criteria.grader_hint: 标准化等效标签并检查一致性。

original.criterion: The sheet uses consistent status vocabulary throughout the records and legend.
original.grader_hint: Normalize equivalent labels and inspect consistency.

criteria.description: 该表在可比指标中使用一致的单位和比率格式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可比记录是否一致的单位表达。

original.criterion: The sheet uses consistent units and rate formatting across comparable measures.
original.grader_hint: Check comparable records for consistent unit expression.

criteria.description: 该表避免将空白、破折号或零作为激励金额，而不解释其含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查类似空白的值。

original.criterion: The sheet avoids presenting a blank, dash, or zero as an incentive amount without explaining its meaning.
original.grader_hint: Inspect blank-like values.

criteria.description: 该工作表使源链接或定位器可在呈现的工作簿中使用，而不仅仅是隐藏在公式或注释中。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试代表性链接或可见定位器。

original.criterion: The sheet makes source links or locators usable in the rendered workbook, not merely hidden in formulas or comments.
original.grader_hint: Test representative links or visible locators.

criteria.description: 当用户从工作表的左上角开始时，标题、句点和状态图例仍然可见或可以快速访问。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查初始视口和冻结窗格。

original.criterion: The title, period, and status legend remain visible or quickly reachable when the user begins at the worksheet's top-left.
original.grader_hint: Inspect initial viewport and frozen panes.

criteria.description: 长注释和源代码细节可以通过换行、足够的宽度或实际的单元格交互来阅读。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查代表性的长文本单元格。

original.criterion: Long notes and source details are readable through wrapping, adequate width, or a practical cell interaction.
original.grader_hint: Check representative long-text cells.

criteria.description: 非专业商业销售代表可以在工作现场使用该表，而无需询问作者状态标签、费率单位或警告的含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断清晰度、导航和操作的充分性，而不仅仅是美观。

original.criterion: A non-specialist commercial sales rep could use the sheet at a jobsite without asking the author what the status labels, rate units, or caveats mean.
original.grader_hint: Judge clarity, navigation, and operational sufficiency rather than aesthetics alone.

criteria.description: 该工作簿是一个有约束的参考工具，而不是一个过度自信的节省承诺：它对于对话很有用，同时保留不确定性和功能边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估合理的代表是否可以使用它而不被鼓励错误陈述资格或价值。

original.criterion: The workbook is a restrained reference tool rather than an overconfident promise of savings: it is useful for a conversation while preserving uncertainty and functional boundaries.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a reasonable rep could use it without being encouraged to misstate eligibility or value.

spec.professional_context: This is a regional commercial-sales operating reference for quoting LED retrofit opportunities across utility territories. It must support a quick, defensible conversation while making the limits of sales authority and evidence obvious.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling service-territory coverage across two named jurisdictions without supplied inputs
Distinguishing confirmed, indicative, stale, portal-dependent, and unresolved program information
Presenting rate units and conditions in a compact jobsite reference
Providing a safe incomplete-case path without overstepping legal, tax, engineering, or final eligibility authority

authoring_plan.purpose: Construct a compact, one-worksheet XLSX reference tool without requiring the solver to rely on live internet. The gold should demonstrate how a sales supervisor synthesizes occupational knowledge into a defensible operating reference, while treating current program facts as verified, indicative, unresolved, or unavailable rather than inventing them.
content_constraints: Use Massachusetts and Rhode Island as the named jurisdictions and include major commercial electric utility territories plus a visible municipal/public-power coverage treatment.
Represent a realistic mix of prescriptive lighting, controls, custom/calculated, reservation-based, and unavailable or unresolved cases. Do not require a fixed row count.

Include fields sufficient to test jurisdiction, service territory, administrator, program/measure, customer segment, measure scope, program type, status, rate, unit, qualifiers, caps or limits, pre-approval, trade-ally conditions, recipient, documentation, source locator, source date, verification date, confidence, and quote-safe disposition.

Seed at least one case where a summary page and detailed table disagree, one portal-dependent case, one stale or undated source, one municipal territory with incomplete verification, and one record where a blank/unknown must not be interpreted as zero.
Include a visible period statement, status legend, source discipline note, fallback guidance, and role boundaries excluding legal, tax, engineering, and final eligibility determinations.
Use only synthetic or generic source locators in the gold if needed; never include real personal identifiers or claim a live fact was verified when it was not.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Review the finished workbook against each relational rubric predicate. For territory coverage, verify that each major territory is either represented by a program record or explicitly accounted for with a transparent unresolved/no-program status. For rates, accept only values whose source, unit, conditions, and verification state agree; where seeded sources conflict, the gold must preserve both references and mark the quote-safe conclusion or unresolved status. Render the workbook and test the first-view navigation, filters, wrapping, and legibility. Have one reviewer role-play a non-specialist rep and another audit evidence and functional boundaries.
authoring_plan.offline_feasibility: The reference solution is authored offline from occupationally plausible, clearly qualified records. The task is scored on the solver's synthesis and evidence discipline, not on live web access or a concealed exact incentive amount.

deliverables.description: A single-worksheet, jobsite-usable utility incentive reference sheet for commercial LED retrofit quoting across Massachusetts and Rhode Island.
constraints: Use the exact filename and save it at the top level of the starting working directory.
Cover both named states and the relevant electric service territories, including municipal territories where applicable.
Make source provenance, verification date, uncertainty, quote-safe status, and unresolved coverage visible.
Do not state unsupported incentive figures as confirmed.
Include a practical fallback path for incomplete or unverifiable cases.
Keep the content suitable for a broad non-specialist sales audience and clearly separate sales guidance from legal, tax, engineering, and final customer-eligibility decisions.

original_instruction:
You’re Bianca Maldonado, the regional sales supervisor at Sedgemoor Lighting & Controls. Cormac Nazari needs a single jobsite reference sheet before the next quarter starts because our commercial LED retrofit quotes keep losing to contractors who can quote an incentive immediately. Build `sedgemoor_utility_incentive_reference.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory. Cover Massachusetts and Rhode Island, including investor-owned, municipal, and other electric service territories that a commercial rep may encounter, and show which lighting incentive programs can be treated as open for the coming quarter. Reps need to find a territory, a plausible LED measure, and the figure or range they may responsibly quote without calling the office. Some administrator PDFs are stale, some details sit behind trade-ally portals, and summary pages disagree with prescriptive tables, so make verification dates, source links, uncertainty, and unresolved territories visible rather than smoothing them over. Include a usable fallback for a quote when the sheet cannot support a completed answer. Keep the sheet readable at a jobsite and do not turn it into a legal, tax, engineering, or customer-eligibility determination; those boundaries matter to Priya Merriweather and Solveig Wickramasinghe. Use only information you can substantiate, and leave unsupported figures unquoted. The workbook must contain one worksheet only and must be saved exactly under that filename.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `sedgemoor_utility_incentive_reference.xlsx` — A single-worksheet, jobsite-usable utility incentive reference sheet for commercial LED retrofit quoting across Massachusetts and Rhode Island. (Exactly one worksheet.; Use the exact filename and save it at the top level of the starting working directory.; Cover both named states and the relevant electric service territories, including municipal territories where applicable.; Make source provenance, verification date, uncertainty, quote-safe status, and unresolved coverage visible.; Do not state unsupported incentive figures as confirmed.; Include a practical fallback path for incomplete or unverifiable cases.; Keep the content suitable for a broad non-specialist sales audience and clearly separate sales guidance from legal, tax, engineering, and final customer-eligibility decisions.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
